  • Upvoting/downvoting through different accounts doesn't work anymore. It used to though.

The best way to deal with all of this is:

  • Every few hours make an account. After a month or so, you should have a few hundred accounts to play with. Let the accounts age so you can hit the 2 month mark.   • Make alt accounts and use them wisely. If your karma hits a decent amount, don't use that account for stuff that could get you banned. Keep that account for the easy and boring stuff. If you lose an account with 25 karma on it, no big deal. You can get that back in a minute.

  • Use PM's when you want to say bannable stuff but don't want banned. Sub mods can't ban you for stuff said in PM's.
